text: I went there with some co-workers on a Friday right around 4pm. There were six of us and the place was very empty. The manager acted like it was a hassle to seat us because they had a lot of reservations and it was going to be busy. As we say for almost 2 hours, we saw 5 total seats sat (outside) and then we were hurried to pay our bill. Because of course all these reservations. . We spent $180 on some drinks and appetizers. Tip well. But will NOT be returning for our usual outing after the way we were treated. Our server was lovely. But this place isn't worth the hassle.

So I've never had huevos rancheros. This my first experience ever, and I actually enjoyed it. I personally asked for my eggs scrambled because runny yolk I just cannot do. The only thing I would say is a little heavy on the beans, but in general if you like this sort of thing I would definitely recommend. I got full super fast too! So overall good especially for $10.

Im a frequent eater at this chain, really like the product and the business model seems very well put together, but nearly every store i goto the customer service is off the mark and doesn't match the rest of it. The salads are always tasty!
Had lunch at the prepared foods bar, Chef Becky helped me out with the many choices they had there. The food was awesome!!

We stopped in, ready for sushi because I've really not had sushi due to Covid. There was only  3 tables (people dining) in the whole place. It was nice and quiet. Our server was really wonderful. They had a lot of specials, which were all wonderful. Live Scallops, Kumamoto Oysters. We also ordered the Surf and Turf roll... which was the best sushi roll I've ever had in my life. No lie. It was live scallop/Kobe Beef/caviar. A bit pricey at $35, but it was unbelievable. We always order the sushi pizza, and other random sushi/sashimi. Take a look at the photos. I still think Blufin is better... but these guys have a bar. The decor is nice... we need to come back for a date night. Check out some of the pictures.
They have mice in the restaurant  me and my boyfriend  ross  were there and saw a mouse the waitress was trying to cover it up  we walked out

The Ice Cream is great but the service is lacking. We stopped by here for dessert after eating dinner at one of the other shops to enjoy some scoops. I think between the 4 adults and two children, we ordered one of each flavor so we all got to try them. All were pretty good. I wish I would have ordered the sugar cone rather than the cake cone but there's always next time. The seasonal flavors were probably my favorite so I'd suggest that!

China Wok is wonderful! The owner is so kind and so personable and often takes the time to come over to your table, greet you, and ask how you're enjoying your meal. The restaurant has some of the most stunning and entailed decor that I've ever seen. Not only do they have a wide variety of delicious Chinese and Japanese foods to choose from, but they also have quite the nice sushi bar. I've eaten there a handful of times since they've opened, and I've always been very impressed with the food, the staff, and the overall atmosphere. I look forward to my next meal there!

What I loved about here is the customer service! We had a great experience with the staff. There are other restaurants in this area but NONE of them welcomed us the way Ember did. Our server took the time to get to know us a minute and recommend some things off of the menu. We chatted about why we were in town and he quickly got us drinks. The food was good and quick, definitely stop in here for a bite!
Unbelievable experience, food, and service. Unlike anything else around. Espeacially great for special occasions and groups.

We went for lunch on Saturday 8/22. We live in the neighborhood and have been here many times. They are under new management and have a new menu and a new chef. The food was quite good. We tried several of the different sandwiches and they were all delicious.

A few service hiccups though. They had no kids menus and told us they needed to print them but then they said the printer wasn't working. Also no crayons for the kids due to Covid. I'm not sure what that was about because normally they are prepackaged but my grandson was disappointed. The other issue was when we asked to be seated in the nearly empty dining room, the person had to ask a manager if they had room for us. Very odd.

Overall, I love this place and it's great to have them in the neighborhood. I'm sure under new management things will improve with service. Highly recommend the food!
Don't come here if you want your food quick. Ordered yesterday and am still waiting. Maybe tomorrow?

I got the Spring Garden cheesesteak.  It is usually a chicken cheesesteak but I asked the nice man if you could make it a beef Cheesesteak and he said yes.  Peppers and garlic are what make it a spring garden cheesesteak. This was a well-made cheesesteak.  I did not like the $8.10 price tag.  At $8.10 it needed more of everything.  I would have loved this Cheesesteak at $6.  Good overall experience.

FRIDAY, FRIDAY, except today is Saturday.  Social dis is a good thang but I couldn't help but to notice some customers were without mask! Food was disappointing and the service as well.  Don't worry I won't be back at this one.

Aussie Grill by Outback is certainly quite terrific. Excellent atmosphere , and service is quick. My friend had to go for their Crispy Volcano Shrimp, and let me tell you, it was really wonderful. Staff are extremely pleasant. They're attentive, polite and always on their game. Definitely coming back again to Aussie Grill by Outback with family & friends.

We were excited to try this new place.  They did a good job with the decor inside.  Unfortunately, we were highly disappointed with the food. We tried 4 tapas: 1) pork and lamb meatballs - dry, not good at all, 2) stuffed peppers - didn't taste good, 3) ham croquettes - bland, 4) patatas bravas - not true to its recipe.  The restaurant was extremely pricey, and in my opinion, not worth the money we paid.  Based on the disappointing flavor of the 4 tapas, we decided we were done trying.  We actually left the restaurant hungry.  Chef Fabio, please revisit the menu offering, we love Osteria down the street, but this concept is not good.  Quite honestly, I don't think the restaurant will make it unless they make some serious changes to the menu.  For perspective, Bulla Gastrobar on S Howard is head and shoulders better, and we will go there to get our tapas fix next time.  On a positive note, the mixed drinks were good though.  Our server was very pleasant. Unfortunately, I don't see us returning here until the menu is changed or another concept takes over.

Have heard great things about this place so I suggested it to my friend for dinner. There isn't a designated lot, but there are parking lots nearby and some street parking.
There's quite a list of taco choices and I definitely had to try a few. The food, atmosphere, and service was great. It was a very nice meal considering the rain outside.
Can't wait to eat here again

A fun place to eat with family and friends.  A chain restaurant with lots of cute t-shirts and bright decor.

This is Mexican food that pleases everyone.  It is priced reasonably.  A good place to pick of you do t want authentic.  The salsas are fresh and delightful.

I do not enjoy giving negative reviews but this place is not my type of place.  I have been surprised by all the high reviews and do not understand them.  Yes, the portions are big but all the food looks the same.  Every dish is covered in some sort of sauce and all the ingredients mixed together.  It is difficult to tell them apart.  

I have been to the original in Austin and it is wonderful.  Here in Indy it is just adequate and there are better options in my opinion.

Tables are close together and the vibe is loud.  You can literally hear every word being said at your neighbors table.  Lots of families with small children.  Outdoor seating during nice weather is great.  

I have been several times with different groups.  The service has always been below par.  Even when it is slow you get little attention.  

Large parking lot but spots are tight at the Michigan are location.  Be careful!  Conveniently located next to Target

We ordered thru UberEats for the first time, and I must say... the food was delicious!! We had the empanadas , 2 steak tacos , tostones & a steak torta with everything and chips/salsa ( salsa has a bit of heat to it but I love it!) I would def recommend this place ! And I most certainly will be back for more.
Great place, and the owners are amazing! Coldest beer in town, and the pizza is to die for!

We found this little spot, and decided to try it. The food was  fresh and delicious. I think the only issue we had was, that while ordering we made the girl taking orders aware that we needed no butter on a breakfast for my husband due to an allergy he has Alpha-gal. She made sure to put oil and as the order was read back to us twice, and even saw the screen to make sure it was there we were confident there would be no butter on his meal. We get our food, my husband bites into his and boom, there's butter. We ask our waitress to confirm if butter was used and she comes back say it was and proceeds to share that sometimes the cooks don't pay attention to specifics. She one, asked did we let the girl at the window know, answer was yes,  and two asked how bad the allergy  was and we let her know we carry pills and an epi pen due to it. Ummmm....regardless of how bad he reacts to the allergy, the point is he has one, and we asked and paid for the accommodation. This was disappointing, and tarnished an otherwise amazing brfst.

We've rarely met a barbecue place we haven't liked and Sugarfire is no exception. We sampled the brisket, pulled pork, and smoked turkey in our most recent visit. All good. 

It's a St Louis staple for good reason. Sugarfire is one of the best.
Great atmosphere with lots of beverages on tap.  Very good food and really helpful staff make for a good time.  Choices for everyone in your group.  Lots of bar seating if your alone to watch sports.

My man raved about this place, he's from the city. I was excited! I ordered the file' gumbo he had a shrimp poboy. I've been a cook for over 20 years this gumbo seems to be made with cornstarch. The food was cool the cheese on my man's poboy wasn't even melted. Won't be turning... and the potato salad omg tasted like mashed potatoes and mayonnaise.

What a unique little spot in a suburb parking lot. The menu changes often so don't rely on the Yelp photos to tell you what's there. 4 of us split a bunch of items and everyone was pleased with what we tried. You can tell they use quality ingredients, make everything fresh, and care about good flavors. I was impressed that their smaller menu was able to cater to various different Asian cultures. For instance, we had: Omu Ramen (Japanese), Tuna Bibimbap (Korean), Crab Rangoon (Chinese), Khao Soi Chicken Curry (Thai). Each was made with finesse, and it tasted so. We appreciated their sustainability efforts, which makes me want to support them even more!

We stopped in for the first time a week ago....and this review is from our third visit since. Well decorated and comfortable inside. The servers have been attentive and our orders have been accurate and quick. The food is over the top. Green curry with eggplant and scallops is bright and vibrant. Pad Thai is excellent.  A family favorite has been crispy duck with panang curry. Wow. The presentation is gorgeous and the flavors are right on. Give them a try. You won't be disappointed.

We had the best Father's Day to go meal! I wanted to get something really special to celebrate with the people I love the most. We had lots of leftovers and we basically just ate and ate all day! Thank you so much for the wonderful food!

This is a great spot for lunch specials and large portions of amazing Thai food. It is a bit off putting on the outside and looks like a dive but is delicious as most seemingly dives are in my opinion!

We met friends for dinner and were seated immediately. There is easy access parking which helps in getting in without stress.

We had a spring roll appetizer -delicious if a bit messy. Love the peanut and spicy dipping sauces!

Our friends had papaya salad and lemongrass soup to start and asked for no mushrooms. However either due to lack of understanding or the noise factor the waitress forgot to mention it to the kitchen. We helped her pick them out and eat them, but here definitely make sure to place your order with enunciation.

Our pad Thai and two otter dishes (forget the names sadly) were amazing and so filling. Mine had a coconut peanut sauce over rice noodles that I could eat for days. Their food makes you want to keep eating until you have to roll out of the restaurant!

We had a bit of confusion with our order which is the only reason this is 4 stars...but in the end they brought everything and in a reasonable amount of time.

No matter how many people are in the drive thru they make one order at a time. This is the slowest place in Tucson. You can get your order for a full scale restaurant faster than you can get it through their drive-through.
Tried Fufu & Eguse soup and it was bomb. The rice was bomb lol the customer service was great.

The legendary Bluebird Café Is located outside downtown Nashville in a very unassuming strip mall. Reservations are a must not available for the Saturday show until the previous Monday.  

Two lines form outside the café before the doors open;  those with tickets and those who are hoping there are seats still available. Someone from inside comes out and asks how many are in your party and allows only those folks in at time. 

It is highly recommended to have cash to pay your cover charge, this night it was $20; it helps with crowd control as the clerk inside seats you after payment, before the next party enters. 

Songwriter Don Schlitz performed his songs including The Gambler and When You Sat Nothing at All, and encouraged the audience to sing along throughout his performance all night.  Jellyroll Johnson, accomplished musician on the harmonica,  accompanied Don. 

If you're going to Nashville this place is a must see!

Food, beer and wine are available. The waitstaff does an amazing job keeping track of your orders; separate billing us an issue

We ordered on line for curbside pickup at 5:53 pm. Their website is great until you pay; we had a gift card and what a mess during the check out process. We included a 15 percent tip for absolutely nothing; please read on. Going forward I will never prepay; wait until after I get my food, make sure everything is correct, and if a tip is DESERVED/EARNED I will include one!

Our curbside order was supposed to be ready at 6:18 pm. We followed procedure and called when we got there and nothing! Went inside and did not receive our food until 07:05 pm. For a restaurant that has seating for dozens of families cannot handle takeout orders. 

By the time we got our food it was two and half hours later from time we ordered, and look what we got for our money.

The food was cold and so

The mushroom burger was ordered medium and was way undercooked, raw!

One the two chicken sandwiches was not prepared as ordered.

The chicken soup was placed in a sandwich container and spilled. You are telling me for $8.50 bowel of would you don't have the proper container l

Unacceptable and disappointing on ever point and every level. Their prices are expensive for what you get. 

I will be calling the manager next day as I was too angry to call after we got our meal. I expect my money back.

This will be our last meal with Cheesecake Factory!

We were here in October 2020. We has the shrimp po-boy and a cheese burger. This was my first po-boy and I was expecting it to be more. It was good but I guess I just thought it would be more. The cheese burger was very large and my boyfriend could not eat it all which was shocking. I wouldn't mind stopping here again.

Good food, great decor, would go back! It can be confusing to find because it's located in the same building as the hospital, but to be super clear it's not part of the hospital, just next door to it.

Lived here 6 years and only just realized how good their food and service are!  The family that runs the business are super friendly and the food, my god!!!! It's delicious and very affordable. I highly recommend and you won't be disappointed!!!

The quality has plummeted since the Diner was launched into silver linings playbook fame. It's ironic because the movie led to no excelsior or silver lining in its potential. It was a local favorite and a diner full of memories through generations but like all too many diners, it's slipping into irrelevance.

Definitely my favorite place in Nashville! The food is always great! Chef Troy and Ms. Gail are also great! I always recommend this place to everyone! It doesn't matter if you're plant based or not! Everything is good!

They only had a few items of the menu!! We even called to make sure they have what we want, but when we got there, we were told they don't have it. Unfortunately the service is not good, but I really like the goat biriyani.

Had the Most AMAZING donuts Ever here this past weekend. I had the salted caRaMel with apple filling and the lemon meringue. It was unlike any other donut I've ever tasted. Very Fresh! Great size! Tasty filling!! Super fresh donut! Great customer service! HIGH RECOMMENDED!! Can't wait to taste their cakes.

Wow! Blown away by the quality, variety and freshness of my sashimi lunch special at Qu.  $14 plus tax and tip was money well spent, and served by the delightful Miss Yvonne. 

This place is brand-new, so new that the liquor license isn't even here yet (Gotta love those PA "blue laws")!

Nevermind, this place is gonna catch on fast.  I only hope that they maintain this level of opening-month quality. Everyone is clearly on their best behavior.

Keep it up, guys!
I'll be back and I'll be watching.

Found this place in yelp and decided to make a trip there for brunch. The waitlist process was easy and the customer service was nice too. The aesthetic was very cute and comfy, while the food looked appetizing as well. The problem is it looked a bit more delicIous than it tasted. I ordered the chicken and waffles- actually pretty good btw- and my friend ordered the bacon omelette with toast and fruit. She did not enjoy the omelette so she sent it back and opted for the chicken biscuit which she said was alright (mostly the biscuit). We both ordered the lyonnaise potatoes that had no flavor at all so ketchup was it's saving grace ...they were a true catfish because they looked so good, but looks only go so far when you're hungry. Anyways, my friend sent the omelette back meaning it was taken off the list, but the toast and fruit were added separately which I felt was a little weird because if you're going to take the meal off, then take the whole meal off even if she took a couple bites but that's just my opinion. Overall, I feel like this is a great spot if you absolutely love French toast because they have a lot of creative dishes but for me (someone who doesn't) I wouldn't come here again on my dime.

Oh my gosh! This place is unreal. All the food was cooked to perfection. You can taste the love in every bite. I had the mixed grill plate, with a side of eggplant burani, which was phenomenal to pair. Then we ordered 1 Baklava for the table, and everyone loved it so much, that we ordered another, and then another and then 1 more lol. Our waiter was a young man, that looked like a high schooler, he was wonderful! He was very kind and courteous, attentive and made us feel good. Can't wait to go back!

This pie was actually enjoyable! We just had a subpar experience at another establishment and still wanted to enjoy a good pizza so we gave Cappy's a try. The pie seemed to have been put together generously and it was very tasty!

Ordered takeout from Crown with their set of 6 pieces of fried chicken, 2 biscuits, and 2 sides (onion rings and mac n cheese). The fried chicken was perfect and oh-so-juicy (especially the thighs and breast) and we even got an extra piece of meat. The sides and biscuits were very standard and quite good (you really can't go wrong with them). The food was enough to split between two people and leave us satisfied.

Wish I could give 0 stars. Came in for lunch the other day and it wasn't all that busy. My brother ordered wings and I ordered a Buffalo Chicken Sandwich with fries ........ I timed it and it literally took 26 mins to arrive to our table. I know it doesn't take that long to cook because I've worked for SEVERAL restaurants and am a Chef myself.... I credit that to the sever not being prompt or even giving a shit if her customers get hot food or not..... When I took my first bite of the chicken sandwich I couldn't even pull a piece of chicken off. It was so hard and rubbery it would not disconnect. Fries were ice cold as well. Which tells me our food was sitting in the expo window at least 10 minutes before it was ever picked up. My brothers wings were cold as well. This Buffalo wild wings is incredibly inconsistent. The one on veterans is much better. Step Up!!! Or step aside cuz y'all suck!!

I was very pleased when I walked In Tacodelphia I come from Florida and those tacos are seriously something. My girlfriend recommended the al pastor tacos and wow they were amazing. I couldn't of asked for my authentic Mexican style tacos like wow the flavors were very overwhelming and just absolutely what I was looking for. I've been to one other place and it was Tio Flores and Tacodelphia was by far way better so if you have a choice consider giving these guys a a try I highly recommend.
It was amazing. Bangin Blackened Salmon Burrito seemed a bit small for me though. The Buffalo Cauliflower bites were great and the crispy chicken sandwich as well. We'll be back for sure
Went here for our first year anniversary. Amazing scallops and steak was cooked perfectly. Service was also great! Highly recommend!

I have been here several times and it never disappoints. My faves are the avocado toast and the açaí protein bowl. They're faves to many others too. There was an 86 on the avocado toast one day and it just forced me to try something different. I had been meaning to anyway. I've had the protein waffle, which is super delicious as well as the surfers breakfast if you're feeling eggs. 

The latte is probably the best I've ever had. I love the use of oat milk. Maybe this is what makes it so delicious but it's also made with love. 

The establishment is clean and friendly. The bathrooms are very clean. I haven't sat out on the patio yet but it looks like a great spot when the temps cool down. 

All in all this is my go to place when my body is screaming for good, clean food. I'm so happy to see this open. NOLA needs places like this and the prices are reasonable.

This is probably my favorite restaurant in Boise (when we are getting take out and wanna be fancy haha). But I totally love that as high end as it is, the happy hour make it affordable! The restaurant itself it quirky and so unique. The food is out of this world. I have dreams about their cowboy steak on the hot rock!!! The stuffed poblano Chile mmm. The Chile relleno  And of course their tableside guacamole.
Their happy hour is so great though. 2 Lemon drops for the price of one, yes please! 
The other day we were there for happy hour and also got dessert and oh my the bananas foster was soooo good!

Great place.  I eat there at least once a month with a group of friends. Kelly is always our server and easily handles a bunch of old crazy oh geezers. Food is always good and consistent. Joe the owner is outstanding.

Got the combo with the tahini sauce and may I say soooo good!! I had it delivered with doordash and the meat inside arrived fresh!! I prefer my rice to be a bit more softer but nothing like splashing water and throwing it in the microwave real quick will hurt. I like my food really hot anyways so it worked out well. The salad they paired it along with is really fresh too!! Ordering again very soon and will have to try the garlic sauce next time!!!

This place is probably as bad if not worse than the restaurant that was at this location before it. Our waitress checked on us once during our whole visit. When my pancakes arrived they were cold, not like it has been sitting out cold, but like they were kept in a refrigerator cold. I ordered the cinnamon roll pancakes and WARNING they come with strawberries Incase you don't like strawberries. Even the waitress didn't know they came with strawberries. I looked passed that because I do like strawberries but the whole dish was cold while the syrup they gave me was hot. 

I attempted to eat it anyways, but when I took a bite of my second strawberry it had a very rotten taste to it and I had to spit it out. I have never had to return food in my life. But I had to at this location. I waited 45 minutes for my food and when it arrived it was cold and the strawberries didn't even taste like strawberries. Worst experience at a restaurant I have ever had.

My husband ordered a dozen-and-a-half clams to take home because I love them. Everyone was Sandy. I've had them there before in the restaurant they were good never Sandy asked for Little necks. They gave us Big Cherry stones. Called to tell they were Sandy and they said that happens when the first shucked. Never like that when you eat them in a restaurant. Very disappointed pay $27 for something you didn't enjoy
Atmosphere is exceptional and a great place to meet friends for coffee, tea,lunch  or fun at the Champagne bar. Great for people watching and having a private party!

I've been here a few times over the years, and have had consistently good food! Even during a busy Saturday rush, they're able to get customers in and served promptly. I only get sushi when I come, but I'm interested in coming back and trying the ramen.

For being so close to my home, this is my first time coming. I've heard amazing things about Cafe Ynez. I got their carnitas burrito, and it was packed with meat and lettuce. I just wished that it came with some sort of salsa - but was otherwise pretty amazing. The guacamole was incredible and they gave plenty of chips too. They don't have any outdoor seating but are doing a lot of take out.  It's fairly affordable food for an area that is close to the hustle and bustle of Rittenhouse. I'd definitely come back, especially since its walking distance for me.
The food is insanely good, delicious drinks. Crispy, tender calamari, delicious lamb, and light perfectly battered fish with delicious fries, you truly can't go wrong by coming here.

The chicken korma I ordered was hot, delicious, and huge. Good thing Indian food reheats well because I could only eat half. It will probably be even better tomorrow. I did devour both samosa today because I could not stop eating them. So happy!

I was born and raised in NY for the first 25 years of my life. Therefore, I have what can only be considered, ahem, -strong- opinions about what pizza is and isn't and what pizza should and shouldn't be.

A large cheese pie from Upper Crust is EXACTLY what pizza is supposed to be. The crust is chewy, the sauce is tangy, and there's exactly the right amount of cheese. Best pizza outside of the New York tri-state area!

Went during the pandemic. They take reservations and check temperatures upon entering. Service was great. Had the crepes, redfish, and pesto pasta. All very tasty, fresh, and light. Sitting on the balcony was nice overlooking Jackson Square, at night it's very dark though...you'll need a flashlight to read the menu. Also had the Brandy Milk Punch, it was delicious and refreshing. Can't wait to go back.

I've been here 3 times in one week for lunch! The bowls and salads are delicious. I took lunch to an office today for 5 people and they ALL loved it! Including the cookies and fruit. We will be back many times I'm sure.
My order got mixed up. I placed the order in English and Spanish.  Staff seemed like they don't wanna be there, I guess I won't be coming back.

Absolutely recommend here for delicious food, great atmosphere and service. Rich is fantastic. We ended up having conversation after dinner between dessert and learned we are not the only ones who feel like we could be in San Fran, Copenhagen, Philly, DC... it's an enchanting and lovely place.

Came here after eating dinner out. Had the Napoleon which was delicious. My sisters had the chocolate gelato and eclair and a strawberry puff desert. I tried this gelato was good. The size pictured is kiddie size which was a good enough size for us to share. Not pictured are cannolis. We had ordered one to eat there but were too full to eat it there. But we ordered to go so took it home. The cannolis are made to order and brought to your table. They were okay. I enjoyed the Napoleon more. Parking is available in front but was full so had to park a block over and walk. We lucked out and found 1 table available when we arrived and when we left the line was wrapped around the building. That in itself says a lot.

Loved this place! Grabbed some soup & sandwiches on the go yesterday and it totally hit the spot. Everything was hot & fresh. You can tell the ingredients are of a high quality...even the cookie was soft & fresh baked. Can't wait to go back !
We enjoyed this place! They have a great happy hour. The fried oysters were the best we had in NOLA.

I came here for a brunch for my sister's graduation in October 2019. It seemed like I was immediately bombarded at the entrance of Golf & Social which was a little worrisome as it was raining outside and I was trying to gather myself. They did not inform my sister at her time of booking that there would be a cover charge of $10 so I was not prepared for that. Thankfully, my sister was and was able to lend me cash. While trying to get her attention for the cash, the bouncer repeated himself over and over "$10 cover" until I finally asked him to hold on a second so I could have my sister hand over the money. We stood around quite a bit when I finally came in but I think that was because we didn't have a confirmed group size just yet so not their fault. When we did sit, the waitress immediately gave us menus and about 10 minutes later she began taking drink orders. The "bottomless" mimosas were $25 pp, this is not including any food or extras. They did have a nice line up for mimosa flavors such as orange, cranberry, pineapple, etc. then we ordered our food and they handed us a stack of Uno cards to play which was a nice touch. Our food came out maybe 45 minutes later. I ordered the omelette and home fries (posted TOGETHER on the menu) and the omelette turned out to be pretty good. It was literally the size of my head or bigger so it served as my breakfast the next day. Before our 2 hrs were up, we were informed that they ran out of champagne and our endless mimosas were over. A

We LOVE King of the Coop! Used to be a hidden gem, but now (rightfully so) they are becoming more popular! They're tucked on Florida Ave. in a small white building, easy to miss if you aren't on the look out. They have a really cool sign hanging that does help track them down. Now, we're chicken fans in this house hold, spicy chicken to be exact! When we heard HOT chicken was nearby we had to check it out.  The staff was so friendly and the shop smells so great with them cooking all the food fresh. Their Mac and Cheese makes you want to take a bath in it it's so amazing. Their pimento cheese is legendary and the fries are seasoned and a perfect compliment whether you get tenders or a sandwich. Every time I've ate here, dine in and take out, the food was fresh, hot and mouthwatering. The prices are very reasonable, especially because you receive large portions. We love this place and HIGHLY recommend you give them a taste.
Soooooooo good!  The sage butter ravioli was insane!  Caesar salad was average.  But would recommend this place for sure!
So glad there's a poke place in Indy. Great quality & flavor. Can't wait to come back!

Looks like they just opened and I have to say I'm glad they're here. The place looks great the folks are very friendly. Good selection so far I've had two different pizzas. The red ultimate and white invernale . Both outstanding! I really enjoy the thin crust squares. Looking forward to working my way through the menu.

if you don't want the hustle and bustle of the quarter for a good beignet, this is your place. beignets are better than that one cafe, coffee is good, and they have a full bar and free wi-fi. what else do you need?! i bring everyone from out of town here, it's a must!

This place is a tourist trap. If you have never had Cajun food before, you'll probably enjoy this place. Walked by and the smell of crawfish loured us in. Crawfish was ridiculously priced at $13.99/lb. 1/2 of the crawfish were dead, the other half was severely over cooked. The tail meat was shriveled and mushy. The gumbo was awful. So slimy. I had gumbo every place I went to and this one was the worst and the only place that was slimy. There's ways to cook the okra to prevent this and this place does not take that extra step. Food was over priced and under delivered. There are so many wonderful places to eat in New Orleans, this is not one of them. Service was okay. You have to ask for all your necessities like it's an inconvenience needing utensils, napkins, water etc. Don't be fooled by the smells, it's trap!

Taste of India on the more eastern end of the Loop is absolutely the best Indian cuisine on Delmar and certainly one of the best in the area. The proprietors recognized me as a regular at one of their previous establishments. Its always nice to be remembered. Service and food is always good. I normally get the same things, Pakora, Butter Chicken or Tikka and naan. All are very good here.

Amazing find!  Thank you to our Uber driver, Tamika, for your suggestion.  Great food and awesome service provided by server MarryAnn, and manager Dale, who totally made us feel at home! A wonderful experience! The food presentation is impressive, as are the chargrilled oysters.

This restaurant has lots of seafood options! Steamed is the way to go for seafood, so everything came out pretty tasty. The shrimp and scallops were great. I didn't try the mussels, but my fiance said they were also very good. We agreed that the crawfish are kind of a waste of money since they contain such a miniscule amount of meat, just the little tail. The potatoes and corn were good. The potatoes were juicy, which I really liked. The lobster bisque was delicious and creamy. And even my dad's chicken fingers were awesome. They were juicy, and their batter was really good; they were like fried chicken, but boneless. The french fries that came with them were also good. I also liked that this place has alcohol, which competitor Crack Crab does not have. My only complaint is the same complaint I have with almost every seafood restaurant, except Crack Crab, actually--the food is too salty. Other than that, everyone in my party liked it!

Best place in town!!! When my family comes to visit this is where I take them. When my coworkers want to go get lunch this is where we go. I would honestly eat here all day everyday if I lived closer but it's so worth the drive. I know they deliver but I love going to the deli, it has such a family feel to it makes you want to stay and hangout a while longer. If you haven't had it I highly recommend trying them out.

My husband and I sat at the bar on the outdoor patio, Danny our bartender was great. Food was ok, we both ordered burgers both of them were not cooked medium rare like we asked, both medium to done, he ordered the sweet potato tots for a dollar upcharge and they were soggy, not crispy. Overall an "ok" experience, but won't make an effort to come back unfortunately.

We were surprised that it was part of the hospital but aside from thinking we were in the wrong place. I loved the decor was very cool and the food was pretty good.  The table tried a number of things they really loved the burger, I had a steak sandwich which was very tasty. Took our waitress a little time to warm up but all in all would recommend. Almost forgot I really enjoyed the red Sangria was delicious

4/5/19 UPDATE- I wanted to give them another try. My son and I stopped in for dinner. I have to say the service was fantastic, staff was super friendly, and the food was fantastic! I had wings, medium buffalo and honey gold. They were perfect, crisp on the outside and moist in the inside. My son had a personal pepperoni pizza that I had to try as well. It was just as tasty. Their beer selection is great too. We will definitely make it a regular meal place.
Steak was like leather. Service not much better. Didn't go out to watch little kids hang out behind the bar.

Usually we visit the Native in Marana, but we were down in town running errands and had a craving for some wings.  They have an awesome deal this June and July of 40 cent wing Tuesdays.  The bar was crowded for the afternoon, and the one worker tending the bar area did a great job taking care of everyone.

We got the chicken and waffles and new Mango flavor.  Sometimes our wings do not have enough sauce, but at this location piled it on!  You can't go wrong with these wings.

I live in the area so I'm super skeptical about the peddlers village tourist restaurants. Years ago i ate at earls before I lived nearby and it was pretty average. 

Tonight at the peak of Christmas shopping ons. Saturday night we decided for some reason we wanted to go out to peddlers village to eat and i thought of earls. Well the food was pretty damn delicious. I had a pork chop that might have been one of the best I've ever had. Came with polenta and you could tell they cooked that for a long time to coax out the corn flavor. My wife's dish of short rib was equally good.

Might have to come back here and grab some more food soon.

I'm not a fish person at all, but I finished most of a fried grouper sandwich. The U-peel shrimp looked and smelled amazing, and fries were great. Shrimp roll got good reviews; the Cuban sandwich is alright. Cole slaw is vinegar based if that's important to you, and the onion rings weren't great, but they weren't deal breakers. So 4.5 stars, and the friendly service warrants rounding up. Definitely recommended
Great food and service! The tables were evenly spaced out so you didn't feel uncomfortable

I have now left the drive thru line from this McDonald's on multiple occasions. The soda machine in the drive thru looks like it hasn't been cleaned in a year. You just sit by the order kiosk and no one ever answers. The food is often wrong, if you can get anyone to help you, and the employees are not polite. This used to be a good location. Not anymore.

This is a small jewel that I stumbled upon by accident while heading to work one morning. So I decided that I would try them out for lunch. 

Here's the break down: 

Customer Service: The staff is super friendly and knowledgeable about the menu and they answered all of my questions about the menu items. 

Quality of Food: I ordered a grilled PBJ and a vegetable pizza. The PBJ is made to perfection!!! That was the first time I've ever tried a PBJ and I was not disappointed! The vegetable pizza was fresh and hot!

Price: 
The prices are reasonable. I paid around $6.00 for the PBJ and I believe $8.00 or $9.00 for my pizza. Not bad...Both food items are reasonably sized so I believe it's worth it.

I've definitely become a regular!
This place is AMAZING. Definitely recommend the turkey panini, mango smoothie, and Thai tea. I go here EVERY time I go to Tampa. Would have them cater my wedding.

We go here all the time.  Was sad when pandemic kept us away but they do have a walk up open now.  We love it and love the staff here too.  Very friendly and the food is amazing.  Get extra yum yum sauce.  You won't be disappointed.  My adult children love the sushi!!  Me...chicken and steak hibachi.

Very bad I went on Monday night and the boy named Raul was very unhelpful I was trying to ask a question and he ignored me & gave an attitude didn't ask me if I wanted sauce no napkins . I don't gets thank you or anything like it better when the girls close at night there much nicer I'd rather go after 12 to not see him thania,julieita & Angie are the most kinds at NEVER GOING TO THAT JACK IN The box

Peacemaker food never disappoints. The warm lobster roll is my go-to. I usually get Brussels sprouts on the side, but went for the chips and they are thick and crunchy (a bit much for my preference). It's a bummer they don't allow substitutions for the sides. 

Our waiter was fine this particular evening, but we've had better in the past. So I'd say service is hit or miss. 

The atmosphere is beachy and casual. We were a little dressed up (nice jeans, blouse, heels), but didn't feel overdressed. The wait staff was dressed down for sure. 

The food is tasty and filling, but don't let the casual vibe fool you--  Peacemaker is expensive. I suppose if you always have a wait on Friday and Saturday nights, you can charge whatever you want! I also realize it can't be cheap to fly seafood into the middle of the country. But just know before you go! Peacemaker is a special occasion place for us.

Best service , Best cortado with almond milk and best crispy bacon!
Love this place and that's why we come back every time I'm in town.

My wife and I live Condado Tacos!  Nearly every trip to Mass Ave includes a meal here.  First off, the staff is always friendly and outgoing.  Second, the option to build your own tacos from a multitude of tasty options is excellent.  They have many different options for shells, protein, veggies, toppings and sauces.  I live trying different combinations whenever we come here.  The taste combos can be fun to explore.  
  Third, they don't skimp on the alcohol when you get a drink here.  I ordered the Chipotle Sour on this trip.  It was sweet, tangy, and citrusy.  Very delicious, and I left feel nice and cozy warm.  
Lastly, we enjoy the environment here.  The art on the walls is whimsical, the open air feeling is roomy and fun, and in the warmer months they open up the garage door style walls to allow air flow and a feeling of street atmosphere.  
We live this place, and look forward to many more trips here.

Food at this location is standard Chipotle fare, however DO NOT EVER ORDER ONLINE. I stupidly continue to give these guys 2nd and 3rd chances to improve but they NEVER, EVER complete their orders on time. I order on their website, leave my house when the order is supposed to be ready, and when I arrive, there are always customers milling about, waiting for their online orders. Typical, at least 15 minutes off. Tonight, 1HR!!!! Better to just wait in line and order in store. Chaos behind the counter. A pity, because the food is good; but the service is wrecking this franchise.
Had the Tony's favorite.  One of the best pizza's I've had.  The combination of the meats with the veggies were great.

Predictable food quality and a decent place for late night eats.  I keep my eyes open for their special offers.  I just got a rack of ribs with 2 sides for $12.99. The 86th street location has plenty of parking.  I found the reserved spaces located by their side door isn't where you can get your takeout, that is located at the front door. Engineering at its finest.  :)

I love this newest gem in the area. It was once home to Zhengs Garden. The previous owner had the area pretty small, and you weren't able to do inside. Now you have a small sine in option. 

The meal was really good! You get a great portion size for the price. I am still giving 5 stars, although I was saddened by them not offering steak with their chimichanga.

They also offer.. great daily happy hour food deals . Like others shared, the gentleman that took my order was very knowledgeable; he even let me sample a small amount of the juice before I purchased.

I'll be back!

Staff was friendly. Definitely felt safe due to
Good social distancing. My partner enjoyed the chili and I had French onion which I would recommend. Sandwiches are nice size. Loved my pulled pork with great onion rings. My partner enjoyed his crab cake sandwich. Definitely go back to try the wings that the were disappointingly out of.
This has always been one of our go to places for carry out pizza.  Greek salad is huge and za is always good.

Omg!!! Tumerico is the best restaurant that just so happens to serve vegan food. It is also pay at the counter and obtain number sort of dining which makes it feel like fast casual dining, but regardless of the dining experience Tumerico has some flavor in the food!

The tacos are so delicious regardless of getting the Cubanos or the Al Pastor, the jackfruit is always seasoned so well and the veggie toppings are fresh and crunchy giving a perfect contrast to the warm and tender jackfruit. I loved the enchiladas as well, the sauce is creamy and tangy just seasoned to latin flavor perfection. The rice and beans and salad sides are also delicious. The salad dressing is a little sweet, but not overbearing which is delightful. I enjoy almost everything I've had here including the curry when they change their menu and other rice dishes. I trust their culinary creations and would get anything they make but my biggest preference is the cubano tacos. The cilantro lime flavor is unmistakably delicious!

Went with the family. Really good pizza with some uncommon topics. Service was really lacking in speed and knowledge. Was told the Greek beer was a heavy lager which turns out to be an pale ale. Also he admitted he forgot to give us the check so had to hunt him down.
The food was mediocre and service was slow. The bathrooms definitely need cleaned more often. There were no locks on the doors in the women's restroom. Go somewhere else.

Service was awful.  We were seated right away and placed our order.  The waitress was Refilling our water and checking in every once in a while and then nothing. After several minutes she came to our table to tell us that she forgot to put the order and that it would be a couple minutes. We figured she put the order in right away and said hey we need to make this because I forgot their order -but 20 minutes later I asked someone to check on the order because we hadn't seen our waitress. she said it would be a couple minutes. I set a timer, 6 1/2 minutes later we had to leave because we had already been at the restaurant for 1 hour and 20 minutes.  
This was supposed to be a quick healthy meal before sending my kids back to college.   Not a good impression for a new restaurant.

I ordered honey BBQ chicken bites. I got buffalo chicken bites. I ordered a strawberry limeade.. I got a strawberry slush. The only thing I DID get right was my m and m sonic blast. So out of my $11 lunch $3 or it was right. I don't know if the lady just couldn't understand my English but needless to say I got home and I am pissed.

The food is great here, and the service is even better. The meals are consistent and are great for take out as well. Kannan makes the experience, incredible server host and do it all-er. He is knowledgeable on all of the dishes and is willing to make spicier or less depending on preferences.

During these times it's nice to have this place around.

Yesterday I went here for some take out lunch. I called, she said it would be ready when I arrive. It was and in a matter of 10 minutes. The food was hot, fresh and plentiful. Left her a nice fat tip and she was so appreciative.

Go here and support this wonderful family, not only now but in the future too!

Their beef brisket shaved noodles, as others have reviewed is definitely by far my favorite! Even for take out, the thick noodles ensure that it won't get too soggy quickly. The broth is intense and full of flavor and overall it's a very filling dish, a bang for your buck. The noodles are always springy and chewy.

You can always order on the phone and head over to pick up which is what I would definitely recommend. 

They do take Venmo/Cash! And there's an ATM on site.
Super yummy, fresh and fast!! Hands down the only place I will get Chinese from here on the West side!
Love this little place!  I enjoyed their bowl,seasoned chips and who doesn't love a giant bar of hot sauces!!
Some of the best service and food we've had. The food was amazing. Better then most places on the hill and that's saying a lot.
Blueberry crumb pie was excellent! Unfortunately the price prevents it from becoming a regular event. Special events or treat only.

First time going there and I LOVED the food, as a person who was tons of allergies w/ food I can't believe I never went there before. Food and smoothie are delicious, the back area it's cozy but had a weird noise that comes from the next door houses unfortunately but besides that everything else was perfect. I will def comeback.

Heard about this place from friends. First, don't try to park out front, there's only two places. Go arouund  back and use pay parking. After signing inn, yes there's going to bee a wait. So grab a drink and relax. Note to owner, give the outside bar a blender.  We waited about ten minutes. The place is small, but well worth the wait. This has become my favorite place for Mexican. Everything we had wAs great!!!  Staff very courteous and friendly. If you come in from the back you walk through the kitchen. I actually liked thIs. Clean and busy!!!
If you're in the area and want a great meal it's definitely a must. You won't be  Great job VIP!!!

Ordered lunch from here was left feeling unfulfilled. We ordered an empanada de picadillo (beef), steak nachos l, and cajeta churros. As actually never received our empanada and instead we're given a beef huarache. Was all the way back to our hotel when we found out so it was too late to do anything about it. The huarache was disappointing. It was more like a large taco. The huarache did not have any thickness to it. The beef seasoning and flavored was just off and I was off out by the peas and carrots cooked in the meat. The steak nachos were more like nachos with steak fajitas on top of them which consisted of a ton of bell peppers. Had we wanted fajitas we would have ordered them. The churros were good but considering we got the cajeta ones we would have expected more cajeta to be included. They did include a tiny cup of hot chocolate for dipping which I thought to be creative and cute. Overall this meal was average and all the flavors are just a bit off to make you not want to order that item again. Not likely I'd recommend but might return for a hot chocolate on a cold day.
Stopped by after a round of golf. Lovely sitting out on their deck overlooking the 18th hole. Service was attentive, margarita was delicious, and food was very good. Will be back.
when ever i ordered for pick up, somehow they always mass it up. HOW  HARD IS IT TO TAKE ONLINE ORDERS?

Love coming here!
I have always had great service, Great food and always super fast and accurate on my pick up orders! Highly recommend!:)
The owner or manager whatever he is, he isn't liked by his staff. Slice $4 pies in the teens.
Wait time to eat after being seated is horrendous! Multiple issues with service! Never coming back here again!
I grew up eating Hawaiian food and I'll say the Food here is FIRE!!! And the hospitality is even better!! Great place to eat!
Their Mac and cheese is amazing! Also felt very safe picking up my curbside pickup order, it was ready and waiting at the promised time.

Not the best food here, the view was nice but that was about it. Our waiter made us wait till he cashed out another party before giving us our bill. After we had been sitting there for about two hours... a few of my other family members ended up leaving while others waited for the bill.

Awesome food awesome service! Charming dining room and staff! Excellent homemade soups and the pizza is second to none! They are homemade rolls are the perfect reason to order one of their amazing grilled chicken Caesar salad's with the house balsamic - amazing! What a find!

Bazbaux does NOT understand food allergies!!
My wife and I waited over 40 minutes for our pizzas. Both pizzas were beyond hammered. Cooked too long and then left to sit for a long time before getting to us. 
Then after I ate half my pizza, they come with a whole new pizza for me because mine had gluten, which I ordered gluten free. 
So they knew they served me something I was allergic to, but couldn't be bothered to tell me that important fact until it was way too late. 
I had to tell the manager (who hid in the back, by the way letting the server take my heat) that he was comping my meal.  The second pizza was also over cooked and not tasty. The pic is of the replacement pizza.

They don't understand food allergies. Eat at your own risk.

UPDATE: May 28, 2019

The owner reached out to me in a respectful manner and made an effort to correct my opinion. I appreciate this and thought it best to inform you. The review stands for now, but perhaps could change.

Probably one of the best pizza places in Fishers. I've only ordered their pizza and salads (all the homemade salad dressings are awesome!). The stars are for the unique pizza offerings. Negatives are : Their take out business must be through the roof during the Covid stay at home order because it takes forever to get through on the phone to order. They should actually look for a new location, the kitchen is really small and dark and the people working seem really stressed. Prior to the virus I'd eaten in the dining room and it is pretty small and lacks atmosphere. Wouldn't suggest it for large parties (over 8).

I started ordering ocean blue through Uber eats and was impressed at the quality and presentation for to go so decided to make the trip there. It was well worth it. Excellent quality, great service. Just wish the rolls were a little cheaper..
Just moved to Burlington, and got Coffee from here today. It was fantastic!! Will definitely be going here often. Highly recommend stopping by.
Amazing home cooked meals! The burgers are great, roast beef poboys This neighborhood restaurant gives you a taste of the simpler times!

Bawarchi... you were my favorite but with each recent visit I feel the food and the experience has changed and my rating has to reflect it.

I used to be able to order just about any dish and find merits to rave about. I'd forgive any shortcomings thanks to the bold and beautiful flavors and interesting preparations found throughout the diverse menu which made you stand out amongst all other Indian restaurants in the community. I'd even say I ordered wrong when something really left me wanting more, resolved to order something new the next time.

The food on this visit really left me perplexed. An old favorite, veggie pakora, packed the same great flavor punch but had half as much of the crunch I'm used to. The main courses arrived all at once but each just lukewarm. I had actually heard the kitchen ring the bell a few times to get the front of house attention and assumed it was for our meal since there were only two other tables at the time. 

We meant to order Gobi (cauliflower) Pepper Masala but mistakenly ordered Aloo Gobi (potato and cauliflower), no big deal, and found the dish to be mostly potato which was undercooked. We ordered an Andra roasted chicken dish (on the bone) and while the sauce was delicious, the chicken was mostly bone. The bainghan bartha (a favorite eggplant dish) was very watery and actually bland, which I've never said about Indian before, and the garlic naan seemed under cooked. 

Thankfully, as has become tradition here, we found one real home run

It's rare that I post a negative review, but I am still in disbelief regarding the price of my lunch today. I came to PDQ on my lunch break, wanting something simple and low-calorie. I figured that ordering grilled tenders and rejecting the meal option for just a water would be the best choice. If I had known that 4 scrawny slices of chicken was going to cost almost $7, I would have gone somewhere else. The tenders were not even seasoned- do you see any seasoning in the photo? The only flavor came from the sauce- which was thankfully tasty. The 2 stars are for the service- the staff was all VERY friendly and put out the orders very quickly.

DO NOT order from here! If I could do no stars I would. Placed an order for delivery, restaurant accepted the order and was given an ETA for when it would be done, after an hour after that time, It was never delivered. Tried calling MANY times and no answer and voicemail was full (surprise surprise). Drove to the restaurant and they closed for the night and never processed the order (but they did process the payment!) NEVER ORDER HERE. I was one of 4cars in the lot with the same issue. Horrible, shady service. Now I need to go through the process with my CC company to try to get my money back. DO NOT GO HERE!

We went here to try this place... and we were not impressed.  It was on Taco Tuesday, my son ordered a burrito, and I ordered two hard shell tacos (1 w/steak, and 1 w/chicken) plus a chicken Chimichanga. The steak was barely luke warm, and the chicken was canned chicken?! I was totally shocked! I was expecting real chicken, shredded chicken... nope. Canned chicken?! Sorry, but not impressed... and not returning.

I had been meaning to make time to stop in and try the food at Three Carrots for a while, and I finally was able to find the time this past fall (2019). They had a wonderful menu full of vegan/vegetarian options, and I was even able to find some gluten-free items on the menu. The staff was friendly and helpful without being on top of you (which I really appreciated). They have both indoor and outdoor seating (at least at the location in Fountain Square), and I was able to bring a book and read and enjoy a nice lunch without too much commotion despite the fact that the patio area is right off of Virginia Avenue. The food menus are full of healthy, fun, and delicious options for both adults and children.

We made a reservation through open table and when we got there, we were told it was first come, first serve. All the tables were full, which is understandable as it is all outside. But why utilize open table if they're not going to honor it?

Employees don't wear masks. (Seen this myself). Owner/ Employees insult, threaten, and kick out patrons questioning their bad hygiene practices (from a friend) this is not an establishment that deserves to continue being in business

Stopped here on an off chance and this is definitely a low end diner.  It's run down, dirty looking with inattentive staff and sucky food.  

The coffee is horrible watered down, the butter wasn't even butter, it just looked like it.  The potatoes tasted at least a day or two old.  My husbands bacon was undercooked.  Ordered an egg white omelet and got a greasy mess that didn't even have all the toppings asked for.  Breakfast food is about as simple as it gets to cook so to screw that up makes no sense.  Not certain how it has gotten good ratings! Stay away if you like your breakfast to be palatable!

Went there twice. The second time only because a friend wanted to try the place. My experience was the same as the first. Good food and a staff that was more into themselves and playing on there computers then waiting tables.

Still the best fast food value in the Nashville area. Their burgers actually taste like they're fresh off the grill and they're hot and steaming with plenty of toppings to choose from to boot. The sides are all pretty great but the cheese balls are on a whole other level. And prices can't be beat, srsly.

Loving the fact that SB Public Market has extended their seating out to Victoria Street. 

Empty Bowl has always been our go-to Thai noodles spot (Summer Rolls, Hangover Noodles, Papaya Salad), as well as Corazon Cocina (Tasty salads, several Taco dishes, all delicious!), Wabi Sabi for Sushi (also delicious Bowl dishes, tasty salads, and yes, fresh Sushi and Sashimi), Ca'Dario Pizza Veloce (tasty and hot pizzas), Fala Bar (100% Vegan, 100% delicious!), and always Rori's Creamery for desserts.

Also, being able to order up a cold frosty beer from The Garden makes the outside dining even better.

Today was my second visit in less than a week because the food was tasty and fresh. It will also be my last because we ordered two fresh juices and the cups were not completely filled. The reason given was we did not want ice. I have never patronized an establishment and been given a beverage partially-filled (and I never get ice). I thought I'd found a new place to eat, but I was wrong.

Meh
This truly needs the 3.5 star 
Listen to Yelp- y'all know!!!

Similar to a few places 'round these parts- great for atmosphere and drinks- all fruity- tropical -style 
But don't go there for the feeling of a solid meal. This is a drinks an apps place only. Great place to watch sunset, people watch and chill. Love the decor
Great service but fell short on the food. Don't get me wrong, what we had was good- burger sliders, eggs rolls stuffed with chicken (hint add coriander sour cream) tuna summer roll and pontine tater tots 
The poutine was tops - but I had to share with 5 other adults booooo

Absolutely love this place! Right on the water which makes for a perfect hangout with beautiful pictures! The service was wonderful and the food was amazing!! You get a lot of food for you buck! Highly recommend!!

I can't believe I've never reviewed Empamamas. I love Empamamas empanadas. I've loved them since the food truck days. Stephanie is so friendly and the food is amazing! The Tampa Girl (think Cuban sandwich in an empanada) is my favorite. So flavorful. The chicken fingers are tasty, too.  I live in Palm Harbor now, but I still make the drive to Armature Works for my Tampa Girls. I do wish they would bring back curbside pick up in these crazy times. I really loved that!

We were looking forward to this winery given the good reviews. However, we didn't get to try anything as we were basically kicked out upon arrival. My husband and I walked in today with our one-year-old daughter in her stroller.  Our daughter was quiet and well-behaved. The woman behind the counter said that they didn't serve anyone under 21 and that we would need a good fake ID for our daughter to allow her to stay. We honestly thought it was a joke at first and laughed. And then we realized she was serious. 
Look, I realize not every establishment is child/family-friendly. I know that some people don't have and don't want to deal with children. And that is honestly fine. My husband and I try really hard to keep our daughter well behaved and quiet in public. 
Obviously, this winery is not child-friendly, and I would've had more respect for them if they had just come out and said that as opposed to hiding behind "we don't serve minors". Of course you don't, and how insulting to imply. The whole exchange was uncomfortable and bizarre. 
By the way, we have been vacationing in California this entire week and have done wine tastings at several vineyards throughout Napa and Santa Barbara. This was the first place to make us feel unwelcome with a child. 
We went on to another Solvang winery and two breweries, enjoying great beverages and service at each. 
Wish I could recommend these wines, but we didn't even have the opportunity to taste them. What a shame.
Absolutely amazing! Delicious food, easy online ordering and drive thru pick up. Person who gave us our food was wearing mask and gloves, also double checked our order. Can't wait to order again!

Worst service waited for our order to be ready an hour and a 40min  . Ladies were taking their sweet time dancing and talking, we were willing to wait the half hour they told us. When we checked on our order they were "almost" done. Our ticket was already put away so idk how they were working on it. We decided to just ask for our money back.  Oh and to top of off while waiting for our refund one of the ladies dropped a Lysol spray in the ice cream and did not switch out or let anyone else know and continue making food.
Amazing pizza at a fair price! I love having a spot to visit in Kenner! The gelato is always a plus!

This is an Uber Eats order!
I was in Tarpon Springs today and for various reasons missed out on some great Greek food.
Next best thing let's order!
I had the Greek Burger - large portions, flavorful, fresh and so well packed!  I ate the whole thing and didn't spill any of it not because there wasn't a tons of everything but because it was packed so well that nothing fell out! I was most impressed by the ratio of tzatziki & feta to the wrap!  Perfect!
Fries - if you've read any of my reviews you know fries are my thing and this place is a winner!!! Perfectly cut & seasoned I didn't need to add anything and just the right portion to the wrap!  I'd order their fries ANY DAY!
Baklava Cheesecake - seriously this is why I chose this place and I'm so glad because I wasn't disappointed.  Can't wait to be able to enjoy a meal at their physical location!  Another great find in Tamp!

Our palace experience was nothing short of amazing. I wish I remembered our waitress' name but the young lady was a delight and a true asset to the restaurant. Kudos! We visited on a Sunday afternoon and were promptly seated. They are actively practicing social distancing and there is hand sanitizer at every station, all staff were in mask. All guest wore mask unless actively eating. 

The duck was spectacular! Yes my date absolutely adored it. It was truly some of the best duck we have ever tasted. cheers to the chef. We loved the crab claws, banana foster and the chocolate cake. Everything was so flavorful and inspiring! I am so in love with the palace. Don't forget to order the bananas Foster drink! We will absolutely be back on our next visit. Thank you for such a wonderful culinary adventure!
